title: Windows 11
requirement: Audit Enterprise and standalone Windows 11 configuration against applicable selected CIS profile.
acceptance_evidence: Run on supported Windows 11 test hosts; validate policy results against known secure/insecure configurations.

title: Windows Server 2019
requirement: Collect and assess applicable server-local security controls and relevant policy state.
acceptance_evidence: Validate on a Windows Server 2019 VM; record evidence for each supported control.

title: Ubuntu 20.04/22.04
requirement: Collect and evaluate Ubuntu-specific system, SSH, account, service, firewall and audit settings.
acceptance_evidence: Run version-specific tests on both LTS versions; no unsupported checks silently pass.

title: RHEL 8/9
requirement: Audit RHEL-specific controls including SELinux, audit rules, accounts and services.
acceptance_evidence: Pass independently reviewed tests on both major versions.

title: Fortinet firewall
requirement: Collect and assess supported FortiOS management and policy configuration.
acceptance_evidence: Verify vendor/model/firmware handshake and known fixture results.

title: Cisco firewall
requirement: Support documented Cisco ASA and/or FTD- family flows with explicit family handling.
acceptance_evidence: Execute family-specific collection and tests; label compatibility precisely.

title: Check Point firewall
requirement: Collect management-policy and device configuration from authorized management interfaces.
acceptance_evidence: Validate policy extraction, normalization and checks on supported versions.

title: Sophos firewall
requirement: Collect and parse supported Sophos firewall configuration using applicable API/CLI.
acceptance_evidence: Validate version-specific fixtures and at least one authorized lab integration.

title: Palo Alto firewall
requirement: Collect PAN-OS configuration and policy via supported REST/XML interfaces.
acceptance_evidence: Verify current committed state and relevant objects in findings.

title: Cisco router
requirement: Audit IOS/IOS-XE or other explicitly supported Cisco router families.
acceptance_evidence: Test Cisco router fixtures, command authorization and rule results.

title: Cisco switch
requirement: Audit supported managed Cisco switch families and Layer-2 hardening.
acceptance_evidence: Test VLAN, interface, port-security and switch-specific findings.

title: Live collection
requirement: Securely retrieve actual configuration/state from authorized managed devices.
acceptance_evidence: Audit run logs source, timestamp, identity, retrieval success and evidence hash.

title: Central multi-target audits
requirement: Schedule and execute audits across multiple asset categories from one interface.
acceptance_evidence: Single job contains mixed supported devices; per- device result and failure isolation.

title: OS collectors
requirement: Collect Windows/Linux local policies, users, processes and system security state.
acceptance_evidence: Collector outputs canonical evidence with explicit missing-data status.

title: Network collectors
requirement: Collect firewall, router and switch running/effective configuration as available.
acceptance_evidence: Adapter tags vendor, device family, firmware and collection method.

title: Deterministic rule engine
requirement: Evaluate versioned CIS-aligned controls with reproducible operators, not AI/ML.
acceptance_evidence: Repeat identical input/profile -> identical result and evidence links.

title: Modular structured rule files
requirement: Support maintainable, validated YAML/JSON and XML/SCAP where applicable.
acceptance_evidence: Schema-invalid rule rejected with clear diagnostic; valid pack loads.

title: Custom baselines
requirement: Allow organization thresholds/overrides separate from benchmark source.
acceptance_evidence: Changing override changes only appropriate checks and preserves history.

title: Benchmark update maintenance
requirement: Track benchmark version/profile and controlled change to rule packs.
acceptance_evidence: Old audit remains reproducible; new version diff is reviewable.

title: Management plane security
requirement: Audit Telnet/HTTP management restrictions as applicable to device/config.
acceptance_evidence: Unsafe management interface produces documented failure and evidence.

title: SSHv2, key auth, timeout
requirement: Check SSH version, permitted auth method and idle timeout where supported.
acceptance_evidence: Fixtures distinguish compliant/weak/unknown management configurations.

title: Over-permissive ACLs
requirement: Detect broad allows such as permit ip any any in effective context.
acceptance_evidence: Parser respects ACL order/context and produces evidence/location.

title: Sensitive port exposure
requirement: Detect risky inbound rules from broad sources to 22/3389/445 and extensible port list.
acceptance_evidence: Exposure scenario uses actual effective policy and source/destination scope.

title: Shadowed rules
requirement: Identify fully shadowed or unreachable ordered firewall/ACL rules where model supports it.
acceptance_evidence: Constructed fixture detects known shadowed rule without false pass.

title: Default-deny policy
requirement: Assess applicable implicit/explicit final action and exceptions.
acceptance_evidence: Correct results on deny, permit and unknown cases.

title: Unused switch ports
requirement: Check designated unused ports are administratively disabled.
acceptance_evidence: Unassigned enabled ports flagged with inventory- based applicability.

title: Port security / MAC binding
requirement: Verify switch edge-port restrictions and configured limits.
acceptance_evidence: Known secure/insecure port security fixtures return expected outcomes.

title: DHCP snooping
requirement: Evaluate feature state, trusted ports and VLAN applicability.
acceptance_evidence: Flags missing scope or unsafe trust with exact interface evidence.

title: Dynamic ARP inspection
requirement: Evaluate DAI/ARP-inspection settings and trust boundaries.
acceptance_evidence: Flags disabled/mis-scoped protections where supported.

title: VLAN 1 management traffic
requirement: Detect use of default VLAN for management where applicable.
acceptance_evidence: Report actual management VLAN and evidence.

title: Syslog forwarding
requirement: Verify remote logging destinations and security-relevant configuration.
acceptance_evidence: Missing/invalid forwarding recorded as failing or unknown with reason.

title: NTP synchronization
requirement: Verify time source configuration and available sync status.
acceptance_evidence: NTP configured vs merely present distinguished in results.

title: SNMP security
requirement: Flag default v1/v2c strings; validate version 3 controls where supported.
acceptance_evidence: Sample public/private communities fail; configured v3 is inspected.

title: Central GUI dashboard
requirement: Provide searchable device overview, audit initiation and findings pages.
acceptance_evidence: Authorized reviewer navigates complete audit without command line.

title: Compliance/severity breakdown
requirement: Display overall and category compliance with Critical/High/Medium/Low distribution.
acceptance_evidence: Score excludes unassessed/errors; coverage reported separately.

title: Expected vs actual findings
requirement: Present rule, expected value, actual observation and evidence side-by-side.
acceptance_evidence: Every failed automated control links to evidence and rule version.

title: Actionable remediation
requirement: Show vendor/version-specific safe guidance and exact CLI where reliably applicable.
acceptance_evidence: Remediation includes prerequisites, risk warning and command/source mapping.

title: Reports and scale
requirement: Export PDF/HTML/CSV/JSON with passes, fails, severity, evidence and remediation; scale across assets.
acceptance_evidence: Four formats reconcile with same audit; load test records latency and failures.

title: Asset inventory
requirement: Searchable centralized asset registry.
acceptance_evidence: Create, edit, retire and filter asset records.

title: Authorized discovery
requirement: Discover eligible targets only within approved ranges.
acceptance_evidence: Discovery logs scope; out-of-scope assets are excluded.

title: Tag/group assets
requirement: Group by site, environment, owner and criticality.
acceptance_evidence: Tags control filters and policy assignment.

title: Scheduled scans
requirement: Run recurring audits without manual action.
acceptance_evidence: Schedule triggers expected job and records time.

title: Drift alerts
requirement: Detect relevant config changes between snapshots.
acceptance_evidence: Controlled change produces accurate change event.

title: Configuration snapshots
requirement: Retain encrypted, versioned configuration evidence.
acceptance_evidence: Snapshot can be decrypted by authorized actor and hash checked.

title: Compliance trends
requirement: Compare audit scores with consistent benchmarks and coverage.
acceptance_evidence: Time-series view reflects historical results accurately.

title: Selective audits
requirement: Scan chosen devices, groups, rule packs or controls.
acceptance_evidence: Selection matches executed checks and job manifest.

title: Distributed workers
requirement: Execute collectors across approved networks/sites.
acceptance_evidence: Multiple workers isolate job failures and maintain tenant boundaries.

title: Offline config assessment
requirement: Audit uploaded/sanitized device configuration snapshots.
acceptance_evidence: Offline results clearly marked as non-live.

title: CIS profile selection
requirement: Choose appropriate Level 1/Level 2 profiles where available.
acceptance_evidence: Profile changes applicable controls and report label.

title: Manual-review workflow
requirement: Assign controls requiring human validation.
acceptance_evidence: Manual item has reviewer, evidence and auditable verdict.

title: Risk ranking
requirement: Prioritize by severity, exposure, asset criticality and evidence confidence.
acceptance_evidence: Risk output reproducible, factors shown.

title: Policy exceptions
requirement: Time-box exceptions with approver, reason and expiration.
acceptance_evidence: Expired exceptions return to active finding workflow.

title: Role-based access control
requirement: Restrict audit/remediation/report permissions by role and tenant.
acceptance_evidence: Negative authorization tests pass for all privileged actions.

title: Multi-factor authentication
requirement: Protect privileged dashboard accounts with MFA.
acceptance_evidence: MFA-required role cannot perform protected action without MFA.

title: Secrets vault
requirement: Store device credentials/keys outside source code and audit tables.
acceptance_evidence: Application references secret ID only; no plaintext in logs.

title: Read-only audit mode
requirement: Collection never mutates device settings by default.
acceptance_evidence: Audit-mode tests show zero configuration-write calls.

title: Application audit trail
requirement: Record logins, policy changes, approvals, exports and commands.
acceptance_evidence: Event sequence attributable and integrity-checkable.

title: Policy version history
requirement: Diff and restore organization rule pack versions.
acceptance_evidence: Historical audit remains linked to original policy.

title: Approved auto- remediation
requirement: Execute allowlisted supported changes after authorization.
acceptance_evidence: Only compatible, approved actions execute and are journaled.

title: Dry-run preview
requirement: Show intended configuration changes before execution.
acceptance_evidence: Preview contains diff/prerequisites; unsupported preview labeled.

title: Approval workflow
requirement: Require explicit reviewer approval for sensitive changes.
acceptance_evidence: Unapproved action cannot run; approval actor logged.

title: Backup/recovery
requirement: Take backups and provide rollback/compensation for supported actions.
acceptance_evidence: Supported rollback passes test; unsupported clearly escalates.

title: Post-fix re-audit
requirement: Automatically re-evaluate controls after change.
acceptance_evidence: Result linked to original finding and change.

title: Alerts/webhooks
requirement: Send notices for critical events and changed statuses.
acceptance_evidence: Deliver or retry notification; secret values never included.

title: Ticket integrations
requirement: Export/route findings into external issue workflows.
acceptance_evidence: Idempotent ticket creation/update with links.

title: Executive reporting
requirement: Provide concise management-level audit summary.
acceptance_evidence: Summary totals reconcile with technical report.

title: Search/filter interface
requirement: Filter by asset, severity, benchmark, status and owner.
acceptance_evidence: Saved filters return correct permitted records.

title: External integration API
requirement: Expose secured machine-readable audit/export interfaces.
acceptance_evidence: Documented versioned API with auth and rate controls.

title: Infrastructure relationship graph
requirement: Link assets, zones, interfaces, subnets, services and controls.
acceptance_evidence: Graph edges backed by configuration/observed evidence.

title: Cross-device correlation
requirement: Join related findings into contextual scenarios.
acceptance_evidence: Correlated scenario retains all source finding IDs.

title: Config-based path analysis
requirement: Estimate permitted access paths from effective ACL/NAT/route/host policy.
acceptance_evidence: Known reachable/unreachable test topologies pass.

title: Root-cause reasoning
requirement: Group findings sharing a verifiable underlying cause.
acceptance_evidence: Explanation names cause rule and supporting data.

title: Evidence-backed risk explanation
requirement: Explain every detected cross-layer security scenario.
acceptance_evidence: User can trace each risk to exact normalized facts.

title: Minimal-change optimization
requirement: Select feasible remediation actions minimizing weighted change impact.
acceptance_evidence: Test solver solution obeys constraints and compares alternatives.

title: Alternative fix comparison
requirement: Present viable candidates with impact and trade-offs.
acceptance_evidence: At least two vetted alternatives on supported scenario.

title: Cross-vendor planning
requirement: Combine fixes for related devices in a coordinated plan.
acceptance_evidence: Plan connects vendor-specific actions and dependencies.

title: Remediation conflict checks
requirement: Identify policy, access and resource conflicts before execution.
acceptance_evidence: Known unsafe conflicting plan blocked.

title: Change sequencing
requirement: Order approved actions to protect management access and dependencies.
acceptance_evidence: Ordering respects graph constraints in fixture.

title: Cross-layer what-if
requirement: Simulate selected network/host policy modifications within model coverage.
acceptance_evidence: Compare baseline vs candidate on labeled test topology.

title: Service-safety contracts
requirement: Define traffic/services that must remain accessible.
acceptance_evidence: A violating proposed change is flagged.

title: Blast-radius estimation
requirement: Identify endpoints/services potentially impacted by a change.
acceptance_evidence: Affected-set reconciles with known connectivity fixture.

title: Safety-gated execution
requirement: Prevent execution when required safety tests fail or unknown policy blocks.
acceptance_evidence: Failing/unverified mandatory contract prevents automated run.

title: Staged rollout
requirement: Apply supported changes through controlled batches and gates.
acceptance_evidence: Unhealthy first batch prevents later execution.

title: Dual verification
requirement: Recheck CIS configuration and real service/connectivity behavior.
acceptance_evidence: Success requires both requested check types to pass.

title: Residual risk measurement
requirement: Report remaining risk/exposure following verified hardening.
acceptance_evidence: Post-state calculation reproducible and evidence- linked.

title: Proof-of-Hardening dossier
requirement: Package before/after evidence, approvals, actions, checks and signatures.
acceptance_evidence: Third-party verifier checks hashes/signatures and event chain.

title: Benchmark upgrade preview
requirement: Compare applicability/evaluation changes across two policy versions.
acceptance_evidence: Preview shows added/removed/modified rules and affected devices.

title: Explainable coverage decisions
requirement: Show rule reasoning, unsupported semantics, errors and evidence coverage.
acceptance_evidence: No unsupported/unknown state appears as PASS; reason accessible.
